read_scope.purpose: Read-only model audit of retained corpus v2 carriers and selected v2 exemplar bindings.
read_scope.corpus_scope: front80 v2 candidate; selected packet sample set only
read_scope.semantic_scope: Five MAIN_TEXT exemplar segments plus the retained model-reader classifications of 97 EDITORIAL samples; no claim beyond the declared samples.
excluded: human corpus audit or human qualification
PDF authenticity, provenance, or unknown-witness resolution
v3 corpus or any newly generated corpus packet
adoption, release, build, catalog, API, or stable publication effect
reclassification of the retained 31 negative page-header opinions

sample_results.carrier_shape: JSON envelope with top-level segments array; canonical reader unwraps segments rather than treating the envelope as a segment.

selected_exemplar_results.reason: 第27回小红传话：观察多层称谓、关系与回话速度。
第24回街面办事：观察差事、银钱与人物声口。
第74回抄检：观察同一事件中的身份与群像差异。
第61回厨房小案：观察真相、体面与处理办法。
第52回针线与病中劳作：观察物质动作推动场面。

negative_crosswalk.negative_reason: Both retained model opinions identify the same 31 full publication-header cases where the WATERMARK_FONT 撫琴居 prefix remains a distinct EDITORIAL segment from the remaining header text; the FAIL is a retained segmentation/boundary opinion, not a missing-record or text-digest failure.

parser_bug_crosswalk.bug: The earlier reader treated a wrapped JSON envelope as one record instead of unwrapping its segments array.
parser_bug_crosswalk.affected_release_evaluation: Nineteen non-86 chapter writing-package false positives were removed after the canonical reader correction.
parser_bug_crosswalk.mechanical_effect: The correction restores actual sample membership and text-digest checking; it does not alter the retained corpus opinions.
parser_bug_crosswalk.corpus_peer_effect: The 19 CORPUS_PEERS FAIL outcomes remain FAIL; no negative review was cleared or converted to PASS.

other_retained_negatives: CH86 remains blocked by three UNRESOLVED_DEPENDENT_SOURCE_ASSET findings in the corrected evaluation.
The retained v2 model review remains FAIL with 31 sample findings.
The final v2 reading/review packet opinions remain research-only and do not establish adoption or release.

direct_read_only_observation.packet_membership: 102/102 unique sample IDs found in the bound segments container
direct_read_only_observation.actual_text_digest_validation: 102/102 retained rows satisfy their own text_sha256
direct_read_only_observation.exemplar_binding: 5/5 selected v2 exemplar segment IDs uniquely found with exact text_sha256 equality
direct_read_only_observation.sample_result_agreement: reader1 and reader2 agree on all 102 retained sample verdicts

no_side_effects_observed_or_authorized: No corpus build or rebuild was called.
No catalog, registry, API, stable release, or existing source was changed.
No v3 adoption or packet regeneration was performed.
No test suite was run; the current regression test source was inspected.

external_requirements: Independent human corpus audit remains required before any corpus authority or qualification claim.
PDF authenticity, source provenance, unknown witness identity, and witness resolution require external evidence; this audit does not supply them.
The 19 CORPUS_PEERS FAIL outcomes must remain unresolved and visible.
Any future parser fix must preserve binding hashes, unique membership, actual text digests, and all retained negative opinions.
No release/adoption decision may rely on this model-only audit.
limitations: This is a model-only, read-only mechanical and evidence crosswalk, not an independent human audit.
MODEL is the qualification of the reviewing process, not evidence authority; authority/evidence is NONE.
Context isolation is NOT_PROVEN for the retained model opinions.
Exact PDF visual authenticity and unresolved witness/source questions were not established.
The sample population is the packet-declared 102 segments, not the full corpus.
The retained 31 negative opinions are preserved even though the wrapper reader bug caused separate false-positive release-evaluation findings.
No claim is made that corrected parser behavior repairs corpus semantics or makes any negative review pass.
